svg.text: Optics bench system wiring: control board, host, motors, laser, photodiodes, test gear
Connector numbers are the control board's (electronics/pcb/control_board) and the photodiode board's (electronics/pcb/pd_amp). All grounds are common through the control board.
USB-C at the board's top-left edge
UART addresses 0-3 set by the board
A0 = PD reference, A1 = PD output
12 V input: PTC fuse, Schottky, TVS, 470 uF
use J5 or J6, not both
Find a coil with an ohmmeter (a few ohms between its two wires).
Wrong direction? Set invert in config.h instead of rewiring.
Plug and unplug motors only with 12 V off.
M12 lens removed; bare sensor in the beam
motor power; logic runs from USB
or bare leads into the screw terminal
Drivers answer on UART only with 12 V on
Check the module label for wire colours.
flywires onto the J10 test header; USB to a laptop
DIO 2 / DIO 3 -> J10-3 SCL / J10-4 SDA (I2C decoder)
W1 (optional) -> J10-9 ADS1115 A2, spare input for ADC checks
V+ / V- -> leave unconnected (board has its own supplies)
J10 pinout: 1 GND, 2 3V3, 3 SCL, 4 SDA, 5 UART, 6 LASER, 7 PD_REF, 8 PD_OUT, 9 A2, 10 A3
